source.title: Court Square Pedestrian Improvements — March 2026
source.status: Dated design presentation; current implementation and consultation status not independently verified

claims.text: The presentation proposes wider sidewalks, additional pedestrian crossings and one-way traffic on Thomson Avenue between Jackson Avenue and 44th Drive.
The presentation proposes signalized pedestrian access at Pearson Street and Jackson Avenue.
The presentation describes a raised shared street on Court Square West from Jackson Avenue to approximately midblock, prioritizing pedestrian movement.
The presentation lists summer 2027 as a tentative construction start and states that project dates are subject to change.
